sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and the Evolution of Prosthetic Valve Failure
sections.description: This section introduces the patient's complex medical history and the chronological progression of his aortic valve dysfunction, establishing the clinical necessity for multiple interventions.
subtopics: Patient profile: Comorbidities impacting surgical risk (CAD, COPD, T2DM, and AV block)
Initial intervention: Indications for the 2014 Lotus valve implantation
Structural Valve Deterioration (SVD): Pathophysiology and presentation of the first TAV-in-TAV (Evolut valve)
Hemodynamic markers of failure: Interpreting mean gradients and ejection fraction (EF) decline
Symptomatology of severe aortic stenosis in the elderly patient

sections.section_title: Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis (PVE) and Post-Infectious Degeneration
sections.description: This section focuses on the complication of endocarditis, the management of the infection, and how PVE leads to accelerated prosthetic valve failure.
subtopics: Diagnosis of PVE: Clinical signs, blood cultures, and the role of Enterococcus faecalis
Antimicrobial strategies for PVE: Duration and selection of targeted therapy
Distinguishing active infection from structural degeneration using TEE and MSCT
Impact of PVE on valve leaflets: Fibrosis and mechanical restriction
The challenge of re-intervening after a resolved infection: Timing and risk assessment

sections.description: Detailed analysis of the diagnostic reasoning used to determine the feasibility of a third transcatheter valve implantation, emphasizing advanced imaging.
subtopics: Multislice CT (MSCT) for anatomical mapping: Evaluating landing zones and lumen diameter
Coronary artery obstruction risk: Measuring ostial height and valve-to-coronary distance
Analyzing 'frame-in-frame' interaction: The cumulative effect of overlapping stent frames
The 'neo-skirt' concept: Predicting how a third valve impacts coronary flow
Multidisciplinary Heart Team decision-making: Balancing EuroSCORE II risk vs. procedural benefit

sections.section_title: Technical Execution of the TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV Procedure
sections.description: A deep dive into the procedural steps and technical choices made during the third implantation to optimize hemodynamics and safety.
subtopics: Valve selection: Rationale for the Acurate neo2 (supra-annular design and frame height)
The 'High Implantation' strategy: Positioning the valve to minimize effective orifice area reduction
Commissural alignment: Technical goals to preserve future coronary access
Intraprocedural maneuvers: Balloon pre-dilation and high-pressure post-dilation
Avoiding coronary protection: Rationale based on pre-procedural CT modeling

sections.section_title: Outcome Analysis and Lifetime Management Strategies
sections.description: Evaluation of the patient's recovery and a discussion on the broader philosophy of managing structural heart disease over a patient's lifetime.
subtopics: Measuring success: VARC-3 criteria and hemodynamic follow-up
Understanding Prosthesis-Patient Mismatch (PPM): Indexed AVA and Doppler Velocity Index (DVI)
Long-term surveillance: 1-year outcomes and LV remodeling
Lifetime Management: Planning for future failures in triple-stented anatomy
Emerging salvage therapies: Overview of BASILICA and bioprosthetic valve fracture
